================================================================================
A slash-run stops where a block comment begins; the operand follows on the line
================================================================================

object Test:
  val a = x /+/* note */ y

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (object_definition
    (identifier)
    (template_body
      (val_definition
        (identifier)
        (infix_expression
          (identifier)
          (operator_identifier)
          (block_comment)
          (identifier))))))

================================================================================
A slash-run stops where a line comment begins; the operand follows next line
================================================================================

object Test:
  val a = x /+// note
    y

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (object_definition
    (identifier)
    (template_body
      (val_definition
        (identifier)
        (infix_expression
          (identifier)
          (operator_identifier)
          (comment)
          (identifier))))))

================================================================================
A slash-run stops where a comment begins; a definition follows next line
================================================================================

object Test:
  val a = x /+// note
  val b = y

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (object_definition
    (identifier)
    (template_body
      (val_definition
        (identifier)
        (postfix_expression
          (identifier)
          (operator_identifier)))
      (comment)
      (val_definition
        (identifier)
        (identifier)))))

================================================================================
An internal operator stops where a block comment begins
================================================================================

object Test:
  val a = x +/*note*/ y
  def m = ???/*c*/()

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (object_definition
    (identifier)
    (template_body
      (val_definition
        (identifier)
        (infix_expression
          (identifier)
          (operator_identifier)
          (block_comment)
          (identifier)))
      (function_definition
        (identifier)
        (call_expression
          (operator_identifier)
          (block_comment)
          (arguments))))))

================================================================================
A comment opener is not an operator
================================================================================

// a line comment
/* a block comment */
val a = 1

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (comment)
  (block_comment)
  (val_definition
    (identifier)
    (integer_literal)))
